assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game VFX ground decal for a realistic isometric dark-fantasy RPG. Generate one isolated irregular pool of black burning lamp oil, viewed straight down (orthographic top view; it will be projected in game). Material detail: glossy viscous near-black oil, subtle amber reflections in tiny wrinkled ripples and bubbles, charred brown-black crust around a ragged feathered perimeter, a few tiny subdued ember fissures. Mostly dark oil, not lava. No flames: animated flames will be added separately. Compact roughly circular footprint, centered, occupying 85 percent of a square canvas with transparent margin. The oil itself remains opaque enough to read over wood and stone, with natural semi-transparent thin edges and genuinely transparent exterior. Fine painterly realism matching pre-rendered fantasy environment art, natural restrained contrast. No floor, stones, planks, scenery, shadows outside the spill, labels, frames, text or checkerboard. Export genuine RGBA transparency.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent flame particle sprite for a realistic isometric dark-fantasy RPG.
